snippet.title: CULTURE IS COMING…⚔️
snippet.description:
Game of Thrones and The Lord of the Rings are AVAILABLE NOW in Doom Bound, the new DLC for Maestro! 
 
👉 META: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/doom-bound/1060908278653634/
👉 STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645630/Doom_Bound/

Save 15% with the Maestro + Doom Bound Bundle!

https://www.meta.com/experiences/1171277090878001/

DLC Content:

🎼 Ramin Djawadi – Main Theme (Game of Thrones)
🎼 Howard Shore – The Bridge of Khazad-dûm (The Lord of the Rings)
🎼 Jacques Offenbach – Orpheus in the Underworld
🎼 Franz Liszt – Totentanz
🎼 Dmitri Shostakovich – Symphony No. 10, 2nd Movement

🎟️ New environment, new themed costumes, gloves and baton.
